eps.d: The first of this new series of films introduces the Hamster, who Is a newcomer to the miniature world of the Riverbank. He meets the Wise Old Frog and makes friends with Roderick the Rat, who takes him on a very exciting fishing trip
In this episode the Hamster and Roderick Rat become involved in a speed-trial between the Turtle and the Frog
In this episode the Hamster encounters a river mist for the first time and is rescued by Roderick the Rat
While Roderick the Rat is away visiting his uncle, the Hamster encounters a stranger in the wild-wood and proves himself to be the bravest of the animals along the riverbank.
Hammy is unjustly accused of stealing Mrs. Hen's eggs, but with the help of the Guinea Pig and Roderick the Rat he is able to find the real culprit.
Roderick the Rat and the Hamster give a party, at which the Guinea Pig arrives in a most unexpected fashion

eps.t: Hammy and Roddy Prepare for a Party
eps.d: Autumn comes to the Riverbank and Hammy and Roderick begin to feel restless. When Guinea Pig offers them a ride in his jeep, Hammy is delighted, but Roderick is not so happy

eps.t: Hammy and Roddy Give a Party
eps.d: Mr. Turtle shows the Hamster a strange craft drifting downstream, and it isn't long before Hammy makes himself a brand-new home
All the animals run away when they hear that the Skunk has come to stay in their neighbourhood. As usual, it is left to the Hamster to make friends with the new arrival.
Roderick tells Hammy about the night when the moon came down to bathe in the river.
The Hamster settles down for his winter sleep and dreams of all the people he has met and the adventures he has known along the Riverbank.

eps.t: The Night the Moon Came Down to Bathe
eps.d: Roderick the Rat teaches the Hamster how to fish and is rather surprised by his friend's catch.
Roderick the Rat and the Hamster suddenly decide to give a party but, first of all, they have to prepare Roderick's house.
A new film series of the adventures of Hammy and his friends. When the Hamster sails upstream on his new craft, he finds the company of Turtle very useful.
Roderick the Rat discovers that it isn't easy to run against the Wind.
A new film series of the adventures of Hammy and his friends. Hammy realizes his wish to go down and talk to the fish.
The Hamster finds that it is a lot easier to climb up trees than it is to climb down.
A mystery of the Riverbank is solved with the help of Guinea Pig's oil-can.
Guinea completes his first test flight, and the Riverbank Air Mail Service is inaugurated.
Hammy's nephews set out to visit him, but run into trouble on the way.
Guinea, Roddy, and Hammy discover a treasure trove.
Hammy's treasure grows at an alarming rate.
Hammy takes a flight to the moon to see if all the stories he has heard about it are true.
Hammy's diving bell is brought into operation once more.
Every animal along the Riverbank is wondering why Roderick is being so unsociable. It is left to Hammy to discover the reason.
The Hamster's nephews, Herbie and Bertie, carry out a daring raid on the Rat's house.
Hammy is rescued by Turtle from an excess of vanity.
Hammy, Roderick, and Guinea discover the source of a mysterious noise.
Hammy goes for a day's fishing, with strange results.
Roderick, Hammy, and Guinea find the Rat's fishing-rod and a new acquaintance as well.
The Guinea Pig takes proud possession of the old water-mill.
Roddy and Hammy make Turtle change his mind about one of his discarded possessions.
The Hamster nephews get into difficulties when they leave Hammy's house to camp in the wildwood.
Roderick the Rat teaches Guinea Pig a lesson when he boasts too much.
Turtle's little hoard comes in useful when Guinea has trouble with his water-wheel.
The Rat receives a mysterious parcel from his Uncle Gepetto.
Uncle Gepetto's birthday present to Roderick produces an unusual problem.
While Guinea enjoys himself with his sledge, Hammy and Roddy solve a mystery.
The friends of Roddy, Hammy, and Guinea witness one of the most daring spectacles ever seen along the Riverbank.
